# Global Tax Guide
> Free, sourced tax-rate reference (corporate rate, personal rate, VAT/GST rate) for every country and territory in the world, including offshore jurisdictions, special tax zones, and disputed/partially-recognized states. Produced by tk.cpa AI Lab, makers of cpavalidated.com.

## Core pages
- [Homepage / Directory](https://globaltaxguide.com/)
- [About](https://globaltaxguide.com/about.html)
- [Mission](https://globaltaxguide.com/mission.html)
- [Special Tax Zones](https://globaltaxguide.com/zones.html)
- [Unions & Trade Zones](https://globaltaxguide.com/unions.html)
